name: Void Noir
storyline:
The rain never stops.

Every shift begins the same way. You arrive at your desk, pour a fresh cup of coffee, and wait for the next case file to slide across your monitor.

Each investigation is generated from real live Twitch stream metadata. Armed with only a handful of clues, you'll search the live internet to identify the correct broadcaster before the trail goes cold.

Build your reputation, solve increasingly difficult cases, and rise through the ranks from rookie investigator to legendary detective.

The internet creates the mysteries.

You solve them.
summary:
The internet never sleeps. Neither do its mysteries.

Welcome to Void Noir, a cozy detective investigation game where every case is generated from real live Twitch stream metadata.

You are not browsing Twitch.

You are not watching streams.

You are a detective.

Each investigation begins at your desk as rain falls outside your office window. A fresh case file slides onto your monitor containing only a handful of clues.

A category.

A language.

Maybe a viewer count.

Maybe part of a title.

Maybe how long they've been live.

Using those clues, you'll investigate the live internet to identify the correct broadcaster before closing another case.

Every investigation is different because every investigation comes from actual live Twitch streams happening right now.

No handcrafted mysteries.

No scripted solutions.

The internet creates the cases.

You solve them.
